data.narrative:
Orbital Operations is a Seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Ben Schleuniger and Ross Doherty that has raised $8.8M to date. The valuation landscape includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers spanning the sector, though narrower peer sets at identical stage and valuation tier are limited.

Given data constraints, only the stage-progression method is applicable. Using total capital raised ($8.8M) as a proxy for seed valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A progression yields $22M. The peer-median approach cannot be applied—while 11 Space & Aerospace companies exist in the comp universe, none meet the dual filters of same-stage and comparable valuation tier, making a narrow peer set unreliable. Public-comp anchoring is similarly not applicable because Orbital Operations' revenue is not disclosed; the sector P/S median of 23.9x across the 5 public tickers cannot be applied without a revenue figure.

The triangulated valuation range is $19M to $25M, with a median of $22M, derived entirely from stage-progression analysis. Key uncertainties include the absence of disclosed revenue (precluding public-comp validation), the lack of same-stage private peer data, and reliance on a single method. Any forward valuation should incorporate actual revenue traction and a broader sample of comparable funding rounds at the Series A stage.
